source.section: Schedule M line 34 Social Security Benefits, 100% at or under the AGI limit and 65% above it for 2025 (PDF p.5; instructions PDF p.28; PDF p.17; Tax Division Social Security Modification page); IT-140 lines 1-8 (PDF p.3; instructions PDF p.26: exemptions 2,000 each, line 7 floored at zero); Rate Schedules I and II (PDF p.37); Tax Table (PDF p.38 on)

worked: Single, age 63, wages and Social Security, federal AGI over 50,000: line 34 takes 65% of the taxable benefits for 2025. filer born 1962-05-20, age 63 at December 31, 2025. Federal taxable Social Security (IRS worksheet, given): other income 50,000.00 + half of benefits 12,000.00 = provisional income 62,000.00; 85% x (62,000.00 - 34,000.00) = 23,800.00 + lesser of 4,500.00 and half the benefits 12,000.00 = 28,300.00, limited to 85% of benefits 20,400.00: 20,400.00. Federal AGI (given) = wages 50,000.00 + taxable Social Security 20,400.00 = 70,400.00. Federal taxable income (given, not tested) = 70,400.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 54,650.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IT-140 line 1 federal AGI 70,400.00. Schedule M additions lines 51-58 none; IT-140 line 2 0.00. Schedule M Column A: line 34(a) total benefits 24,000.00, (b) exempt for federal 3,600.00, (c) taxable 20,400.00; federal AGI 70,400.00 exceeds 50,000.00, so line 34 = 0.65 x 20,400.00 = 13,260.00; line 47: age 63, under 65 and not disabled, none; line 49 = 13,260.00. Line 50 total subtractions = 13,260.00. IT-140 line 3 subtractions 13,260.00; line 4 West Virginia AGI = 70,400.00 + 0.00 - 13,260.00 = 57,140.00. Line 5 Low-Income Earned Income Exclusion: federal AGI over 10,000, none. Line 6 exemptions 1 x 2,000.00 = 2,000.00. Line 7 taxable income = 57,140.00 - 2,000.00 = 55,140.00. Line 8 tax by Rate Schedule I (PDF p.37) bands: 2.22% x 10,000.00 = 222 + 2.96% x 15,000.00 = 444 + 3.33% x 15,000.00 = 499.5 + 4.44% x 15,140.00 = 672.216; total 1837.716 = 1,837.72. The Tax Table row 55,100 to under 55,150 (PDF p.38 on) gives 1,837; expected keeps the schedule formula on the exact income. No Family Tax Credit (Modified Federal AGI above the table limits); credits 0.00; state income tax 1,837.72.
accepted_approximations: Tax below 100,000 of taxable income is figured on the exact income, where the booklet uses a Tax Table row's midpoint rounded to the whole dollar. Other tax is also rounded to the whole dollar in the booklet.
